completion_criteria: Versioned maintainer-only schemas validate representative state, reference, action, result, evidence/claim, terminal, and transition fixtures.
A domain-neutral pure reducer emits immutable revisioned state and complete deterministic transition identities.
Replay is byte/digest stable and invokes no model, provider, AW command, network, subprocess, or repository mutation.
Stale revisions fail without mutation; repeated state/action and no-progress loops become explicit blocked/recovery state.
Atomic persistence and interrupted-write recovery are proven; restart requires authoritative domain re-observation.
Three small stacked PRs cover the full #2822 child without claiming #2821 or stage-2 readiness.
